# This file defines the generated agentic maintenance workflow for this repository.
# It runs scheduled cleanup for expiring safe outputs and supports manual maintenance operations.
#
# This workflow is generated automatically when workflows use expiring safe outputs
# or when repository maintenance features are enabled in .github/workflows/aw.json.

# To disable maintenance workflow generation, set in .github/workflows/aw.json:

name: Agentic Maintenance

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "37 0 * * *"  # Daily (based on minimum expires: 30 days)
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      operation:
        description: 'Optional maintenance operation to run'
        required: false
        type: choice
        default: ''
        options:
          - ''
          - 'disable'
          - 'enable'
          - 'update'
          - 'upgrade'
          - 'safe_outputs'
          - 'create_labels'
          - 'activity_report'
          - 'close_agentic_workflows_issues'
          - 'clean_cache_memories'
          - 'update_pull_request_branches'
          - 'validate'
          - 'forecast'
      run_url:
        description: 'Run URL or run ID to replay safe outputs from (e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo/actions/runs/12345 or 12345). Required when operation is safe_outputs.'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      operation:
        description: 'Optional maintenance operation to run (disable, enable, update, upgrade, safe_outputs, create_labels, activity_report, close_agentic_workflows_issues, clean_cache_memories, update_pull_request_branches, validate, forecast)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      run_url:
        description: 'Run URL or run ID to replay safe outputs from (e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo/actions/runs/12345 or 12345). Required when operation is safe_outputs.'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
    outputs:
      operation_completed:
        description: 'The maintenance operation that was completed (empty when none ran or a scheduled job ran)'
        value: ${{ jobs.run_operation.outputs.operation || inputs.operation }}
      applied_run_url:
        description: 'The run URL that safe outputs were applied from'
        value: ${{ jobs.apply_safe_outputs.outputs.run_url }}

permissions: {}

jobs:
  close-expired-entities:
    if: ${{ (!(github.event.repository.fork)) && github.event_name != 'push' && (github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event_name != 'workflow_call' || inputs.operation == '') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    permissions:
      discussions: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Setup Scripts
        uses: github/gh-aw-actions/setup@3fac1cfa7a5a375a6a5eb9839178f6dad7adb60a # v0.82.2
        with:
          destination: ${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions

      - name: Close expired discussions
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        with:
          script: |
            const { setupGlobals } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/setup_globals.cjs');
            setupGlobals(core, github, context, exec, io, getOctokit);
            const { main } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/close_expired_discussions.cjs');
            await main();

      - name: Close expired issues
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        with:
          script: |
            const { setupGlobals } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/setup_globals.cjs');
            setupGlobals(core, github, context, exec, io, getOctokit);
            const { main } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/close_expired_issues.cjs');
            await main();

      - name: Close expired pull requests
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        with:
          script: |
            const { setupGlobals } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/setup_globals.cjs');
            setupGlobals(core, github, context, exec, io, getOctokit);
            const { main } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/close_expired_pull_requests.cjs');
            await main();

  cleanup-cache-memory:
    if: ${{ (!(github.event.repository.fork)) && github.event_name != 'push' && (github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event_name != 'workflow_call' || inputs.operation == '' || inputs.operation == 'clean_cache_memories') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    permissions:
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Setup Scripts
        uses: github/gh-aw-actions/setup@3fac1cfa7a5a375a6a5eb9839178f6dad7adb60a # v0.82.2
        with:
          destination: ${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions

      - name: Cleanup outdated cache-memory entries
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        with:
          script: |
            const { setupGlobals } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/setup_globals.cjs');
            setupGlobals(core, github, context, exec, io, getOctokit);
            const { main } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/cleanup_cache_memory.cjs');
            await main();

  run_operation:
    if: ${{ (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event_name == 'workflow_call') && inputs.operation != '' && inputs.operation != 'safe_outputs' && inputs.operation != 'create_labels' && inputs.operation != 'activity_report' && inputs.operation != 'close_agentic_workflows_issues' && inputs.operation != 'clean_cache_memories' && inputs.operation != 'update_pull_request_branches' && inputs.operation != 'validate' && inputs.operation != 'forecast' && (!(github.event.repository.fork)) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    permissions:
      actions: write
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    outputs:
      operation: ${{ steps.record.outputs.operation }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Scripts
        uses: github/gh-aw-actions/setup@3fac1cfa7a5a375a6a5eb9839178f6dad7adb60a # v0.82.2
        with:
          destination: ${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions

      - name: Check admin/maintainer permissions
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { setupGlobals } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/setup_globals.cjs');
            setupGlobals(core, github, context, exec, io, getOctokit);
            const { main } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/check_team_member.cjs');
            await main();

      - name: Install gh-aw
        uses: github/gh-aw-actions/setup-cli@3fac1cfa7a5a375a6a5eb9839178f6dad7adb60a # v0.82.2
        with:
          version: v0.82.2

      - name: Run operation
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          GH_AW_OPERATION: ${{ inputs.operation }}
          GH_AW_CMD_PREFIX: gh aw
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { setupGlobals } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/setup_globals.cjs');
            setupGlobals(core, github, context, exec, io, getOctokit);
            const { main } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/run_operation_update_upgrade.cjs');
            await main();

      - name: Record outputs
        id: record
        env:
          GH_AW_OPERATION: ${{ inputs.operation }}
        run: echo "operation=$GH_AW_OPERATION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  update_pull_request_branches:
    if: ${{ (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event_name == 'workflow_call') && inputs.operation == 'update_pull_request_branches' && (!(github.event.repository.fork)) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Setup Scripts
        uses: github/gh-aw-actions/setup@3fac1cfa7a5a375a6a5eb9839178f6dad7adb60a # v0.82.2
        with:
          destination: ${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions

      - name: Check admin/maintainer permissions
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { setupGlobals } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/setup_globals.cjs');
            setupGlobals(core, github, context, exec, io, getOctokit);
            const { main } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/check_team_member.cjs');
            await main();

      - name: Update pull request branches
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { setupGlobals } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/setup_globals.cjs');
            setupGlobals(core, github, context, exec, io, getOctokit);
            const { main } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/update_pull_request_branches.cjs');
            await main();

  apply_safe_outputs:
    if: ${{ (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event_name == 'workflow_call') && inputs.operation == 'safe_outputs' && (!(github.event.repository.fork)) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: write
      discussions: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
    outputs:
      run_url: ${{ steps.record.outputs.run_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout actions folder
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          sparse-checkout: |
            actions
          clean: false
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Scripts
        uses: github/gh-aw-actions/setup@3fac1cfa7a5a375a6a5eb9839178f6dad7adb60a # v0.82.2
        with:
          destination: ${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions

      - name: Check admin/maintainer permissions
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { setupGlobals } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/setup_globals.cjs');
            setupGlobals(core, github, context, exec, io, getOctokit);
            const { main } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/check_team_member.cjs');
            await main();

      - name: Apply Safe Outputs
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          GH_AW_RUN_URL: ${{ inputs.run_url }}
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { setupGlobals } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/setup_globals.cjs');
            setupGlobals(core, github, context, exec, io, getOctokit);
            const { main } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/apply_safe_outputs_replay.cjs');
            await main();

      - name: Record outputs
        id: record
        env:
          GH_AW_RUN_URL: ${{ inputs.run_url }}
        run: echo "run_url=$GH_AW_RUN_URL" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  create_labels:
    if: ${{ (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event_name == 'workflow_call') && inputs.operation == 'create_labels' && (!(github.event.repository.fork)) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Scripts
        uses: github/gh-aw-actions/setup@3fac1cfa7a5a375a6a5eb9839178f6dad7adb60a # v0.82.2
        with:
          destination: ${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions

      - name: Check admin/maintainer permissions
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { setupGlobals } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/setup_globals.cjs');
            setupGlobals(core, github, context, exec, io, getOctokit);
            const { main } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/check_team_member.cjs');
            await main();

      - name: Install gh-aw
        uses: github/gh-aw-actions/setup-cli@3fac1cfa7a5a375a6a5eb9839178f6dad7adb60a # v0.82.2
        with:
          version: v0.82.2

      - name: Create missing labels
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        env:
          GH_AW_CMD_PREFIX: gh aw
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { setupGlobals } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/setup_globals.cjs');
            setupGlobals(core, github, context, exec, io, getOctokit);
            const { main } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/create_labels.cjs');
            await main();

  activity_report:
    if: ${{ (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event_name == 'workflow_call') && inputs.operation == 'activity_report' && (!(github.event.repository.fork)) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    timeout-minutes: 120
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Scripts
        uses: github/gh-aw-actions/setup@3fac1cfa7a5a375a6a5eb9839178f6dad7adb60a # v0.82.2
        with:
          destination: ${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions

      - name: Check admin/maintainer permissions
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { setupGlobals } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/setup_globals.cjs');
            setupGlobals(core, github, context, exec, io, getOctokit);
            const { main } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/check_team_member.cjs');
            await main();

      - name: Install gh-aw
        uses: github/gh-aw-actions/setup-cli@3fac1cfa7a5a375a6a5eb9839178f6dad7adb60a # v0.82.2
        with:
          version: v0.82.2

      - name: Restore activity report logs cache
        id: activity_report_logs_cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ./.cache/gh-aw/activity-report-logs
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-activity-report-logs-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-activity-report-logs-${{ github.repository }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-activity-report-logs-
      - name: Download activity report logs
        timeout-minutes: 20
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          GH_AW_CMD_PREFIX: gh aw
        run: |
          ${GH_AW_CMD_PREFIX} logs \
            --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --start-date -1w \
            --count 500 \
            --output ./.cache/gh-aw/activity-report-logs \
            --format markdown \
            --report-file ./.cache/gh-aw/activity-report-logs/report.md

      - name: Save activity report logs cache
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/cache/save@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ./.cache/gh-aw/activity-report-logs
          key: ${{ steps.activity_report_logs_cache.outputs.cache-primary-key }}

      - name: Generate activity report issue
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const fs = require('node:fs');
            const reportPath = './.cache/gh-aw/activity-report-logs/report.md';
            if (!fs.existsSync(reportPath)) {
              core.warning('Activity report markdown not found at ' + reportPath + '; skipping issue creation.');
              return;
            }
            let reportBody = '';
            try {
              reportBody = fs.readFileSync(reportPath, 'utf8').trim();
            } catch (error) {
              core.warning('Failed to read activity report markdown at ' + reportPath + ': ' + error.message);
              return;
            }
            if (!reportBody) {
              core.warning('Activity report markdown is empty at ' + reportPath + '; skipping issue creation.');
              return;
            }
            const repoSlug = context.repo.owner + '/' + context.repo.repo;
            const body = [
              '### Agentic workflow activity report',
              '',
              'Repository: ' + repoSlug,
              'Generated at: ' + new Date().toISOString(),
              '',
              reportBody,
            ].join('\n');
            const createdIssue = await github.rest.issues.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title: '[aw] agentic status report',
              body,
              labels: ['agentic-workflows'],
            });
            core.info('Created issue #' + createdIssue.data.number + ': ' + createdIssue.data.html_url);

  forecast_report:
    if: ${{ (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event_name == 'workflow_call') && inputs.operation == 'forecast' && (!(github.event.repository.fork)) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Scripts
        uses: github/gh-aw-actions/setup@3fac1cfa7a5a375a6a5eb9839178f6dad7adb60a # v0.82.2
        with:
          destination: ${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions

      - name: Check admin/maintainer permissions
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { setupGlobals } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/setup_globals.cjs');
            setupGlobals(core, github, context, exec, io, getOctokit);
            const { main } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/check_team_member.cjs');
            await main();

      - name: Install gh-aw
        uses: github/gh-aw-actions/setup-cli@3fac1cfa7a5a375a6a5eb9839178f6dad7adb60a # v0.82.2
        with:
          version: v0.82.2

      - name: Restore forecast report logs cache
        id: forecast_report_logs_cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ./.github/aw/logs
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-forecast-report-logs-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-forecast-report-logs-${{ github.repository }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-forecast-report-logs-

      - name: Generate forecast report
        id: generate_forecast_report
        timeout-minutes: 30
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          DEBUG: "*"
          GH_AW_CMD_PREFIX: gh aw
        run: |
          mkdir -p ./.cache/gh-aw/forecast
          set +e
          ${GH_AW_CMD_PREFIX} forecast --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --timeout 30 --verbose --json > ./.cache/gh-aw/forecast/report.json
          forecast_exit_code=$?
          set -e
          if [ "${forecast_exit_code}" -eq 124 ]; then
            echo '{"outcome":"timeout","message":"Forecast computation timed out after 30 minutes."}' > ./.cache/gh-aw/forecast/error.json
            echo "::error::Forecast computation timed out after 30 minutes."
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "${forecast_exit_code}" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo '{"outcome":"error","message":"Forecast computation failed before producing a report."}' > ./.cache/gh-aw/forecast/error.json
            echo "::error::Forecast computation failed with exit code ${forecast_exit_code}."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Debug forecast logs folder
        if: ${{ always() }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ ! -d ./.github/aw/logs ]; then
            echo "Logs directory not found: ./.github/aw/logs"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Files under ./.github/aw/logs:"
          find ./.github/aw/logs -type f | sort

      - name: Save forecast report logs cache
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/cache/save@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ./.github/aw/logs
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-forecast-report-logs-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ github.run_id }}

      - name: Generate forecast issue
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        env:
          FORECAST_STEP_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.generate_forecast_report.outcome }}
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { setupGlobals } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/setup_globals.cjs');
            setupGlobals(core, github, context, exec, io, getOctokit);
            const { main } = require('${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions/create_forecast_issue.cjs');
            await main();

  close_agentic_workflows_issues:
    if: ${{ (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event_name == 'workflow_call') && inputs.operation == 'close_agentic_workflows_issues' && (!(github.event.repository.fork)) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    permissions:
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Setup Scripts
        uses: github/gh-aw-actions/setup@3fac1cfa7a5a375a6a5eb9839178f6dad7adb60a # v0.82.2
        with:
          destination: ${{ runner.temp }}/gh-aw/actions

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@08807647e7069bb48b6ef5acd8ec9567f424441b # v8.1.0

          --with 'pytest==8.4.1'
          sh -c 'python -m unittest scripts.test_price_check_agent && python -m pytest "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/scripts/test_price_check_sources.py" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/scripts/test_price_check_scope_policy.py"'
      - uses: github/gh-aw-actions/setup@d7cc687a9bc76b9d56e6c496649403392f654b35 # v0.91.1
      - name: Verify fetch policy and safe-output scope preflight
        run: >-
          node --test scripts/price_check_web_fetch.test.cjs
          scripts/price_check_scope.test.cjs scripts/price_check_bridge.test.cjs

  pre-commit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@08807647e7069bb48b6ef5acd8ec9567f424441b # v8.1.0
        with:
          version: "0.12.1"
          enable-cache: true # zizmor: ignore[cache-poisoning] -- Job does not produce release artifacts and does not have sensitive permissions
      - run: uv sync  --all-packages
      - uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          cache: npm # zizmor: ignore[cache-poisoning] -- Job does not produce release artifacts and does not have sensitive permissions
      - run: npm ci
      - uses: actions/setup-go@924ae3a1cded613372ab5595356fb5720e22ba16 # v6.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: packages/go/go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: packages/go/go.sum
          cache: true # zizmor: ignore[cache-poisoning] -- Job does not produce release artifacts and does not have sensitive permissions
      - uses: actions/cache@27d5ce7f107fe9357f9df03efb73ab90386fccae # v5.0.5 # zizmor: ignore[cache-poisoning] -- Job does not produce release artifacts and does not have sensitive permissions
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pre-commit
          key: pre-commit|${{ env.UV_PYTHON }}|${{ hashFiles('.pre-commit-config.yaml') }}
      - run: uvx pre-commit run --color=always --all-files --verbose
        env:
          SKIP: no-commit-to-branch

  test-python:
    name: test py${{ matrix.python-version }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.11", "3.12", "3.13", "3.14", "3.15"]
    env:
      UV_PYTHON: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@08807647e7069bb48b6ef5acd8ec9567f424441b # v8.1.0
        with:
          version: "0.12.1"
          enable-cache: true # zizmor: ignore[cache-poisoning] -- Job does not produce release artifacts and does not have sensitive permissions
      - run: uv sync --frozen --all-packages --all-extras
      - run: make test
        env:
          COVERAGE_FILE: coverage/.coverage.py${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: store coverage files
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: coverage-${{ matrix.python-version }}
          path: coverage
          include-hidden-files: true
      - name: test with lowest dependency version
        run: |
          uv sync --all-packages --all-extras --resolution lowest-direct
          uv run --no-sync pytest -m "not requires_latest_pydantic"

  coverage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [test-python]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          # needed for diff-cover
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: get coverage files
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          merge-multiple: true
          path: coverage
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@08807647e7069bb48b6ef5acd8ec9567f424441b # v8.1.0
        with:
          version: "0.12.1"
          enable-cache: true # zizmor: ignore[cache-poisoning] -- Job does not produce release artifacts and does not have sensitive permissions
      - run: uv sync --only-dev
      - run: uv run coverage combine coverage
      - run: uv run coverage html --show-contexts --title "genai-prices coverage for ${{ github.sha }}"
      - name: Store coverage html
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: coverage-html
          path: htmlcov
          include-hidden-files: true
      - run: uv run coverage report

  test-js:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.x
          cache: "npm" # zizmor: ignore[cache-poisoning] -- Job does not produce release artifacts and does not have sensitive permissions

      - run: npm ci

      - run: npm run ci

  test-go:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@924ae3a1cded613372ab5595356fb5720e22ba16 # v6.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: packages/go/go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: packages/go/go.sum
          cache: true # zizmor: ignore[cache-poisoning] -- Job does not produce release artifacts and does not have sensitive permissions
      - uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@ba0d7d2ec06a0ea1cb5fa41b2e4a3ab91d21278a # v9.2.0
        with:
          version: v2.10.1
          working-directory: packages/go
      - run: make test-go

  # Preserve the v2 schema core. Optional model price variants are ignored by older clients.
  v2-schema-frozen:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'merge_group'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: compare the v2 schema core against the base branch
        run: |
          python3 prices/src/prices/schema_compatibility.py --base "${BASE_SHA}" \
            prices/new_data/v2/data.schema.json prices/new_data/v2/data_slim.schema.json
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha }}

  # https://github.com/marketplace/actions/alls-green#why used for branch protection checks
  check:
    if: always()
    needs: [price-check-agent, pre-commit, test-python, coverage, test-js, test-go, v2-schema-frozen]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Decide whether the needed jobs succeeded or failed
        uses: re-actors/alls-green@05ac9388f0aebcb5727afa17fcccfecd6f8ec5fe # v1.2.2
        with:
          jobs: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
          # v2-schema-frozen only runs on pull_request/merge_group; it is (correctly) skipped on push/tag runs,
          # so don't let that skip fail the gate.
          allowed-skips: v2-schema-frozen

  # Releases are cut by creating a GitHub release whose tag is `vX.Y.Z`. Nothing in the repo is
  # bumped: the Python version comes from the tag via uv-dynamic-versioning and the npm version is
  # set from the tag right before publishing. Both artifacts are built in this job, which has no
  # publish credentials, so a compromised build backend / transitive build dep can't reach the
  # OIDC tokens - those live in the two publish jobs below, which only touch the built artifacts.
  release-build:
    name: build release artifacts
    needs: [check]
    # Not success(): v2-schema-frozen is skipped on tag runs, and a skipped job anywhere in the
    # needs chain makes success() false, silently skipping the release jobs (the v0.0.70 tag hit
    # this). An explicit status function is required, otherwise an implicit success() is still
    # applied to the expression.
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.check.result == 'success' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@08807647e7069bb48b6ef5acd8ec9567f424441b # v8.1.0
        with:
          version: "0.12.1"
          enable-cache: false

      - uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.x
          package-manager-cache: false

      # The tag is the single source of truth for the version. Fail before building anything if
      # what uv-dynamic-versioning derives from it doesn't match the tag byte-for-byte: a tag like
      # `v1.0.0-rc.1` would otherwise publish `1.0.0rc1` to PyPI and `1.0.0-rc.1` to npm.
      - name: Derive version from tag
        id: version
        env:
          TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          version="${TAG#v}"
          python_version=$(uvx --with uv-dynamic-versioning hatchling version)
          if [ "$python_version" != "$version" ]; then
            echo "::error::Tag '$TAG' gives Python version '$python_version', expected '$version'. Use a plain 'vX.Y.Z' tag."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        working-directory: packages/python

      - run: uv build --package genai-prices

      # `npm version` rewrites packages/js/package.json before the build so the CLI's `--version`
      # (which imports it) reports the released version.
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm version --no-git-tag-version --workspace=packages/js "${VERSION}"
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
      - run: npm run build --workspace=packages/js
      - run: mkdir -p npm-dist
      - run: npm pack --workspace=packages/js --pack-destination npm-dist
      - name: Verify npm release artifact
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
        run: test -f "npm-dist/pydantic-genai-prices-${VERSION}.tgz"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: release-pypi-dist
          path: dist/
          if-no-files-found: error
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: release-npm-dist
          path: npm-dist/
          if-no-files-found: error

  release-go:
    name: tag Go module
    needs: [release-build]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.release-build.result == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Create Go module tag
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        env:
          GO_TAG: packages/go/v${{ needs.release-build.outputs.version }}
          RELEASE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        with:
          script: |
            const { owner, repo } = context.repo
            const tag = process.env.GO_TAG
            const releaseSha = process.env.RELEASE_SHA

            const getTagTarget = async () => {
              const existing = await github.rest.git.getRef({ owner, repo, ref: `tags/${tag}` })
              let target = existing.data.object
              while (target.type === 'tag') {
                const annotated = await github.rest.git.getTag({ owner, repo, tag_sha: target.sha })
                target = annotated.data.object
              }
              return target
            }

            const verifyTag = (target) => {
              if (target.type !== 'commit' || target.sha !== releaseSha) {
                throw new Error(`Tag ${tag} already exists at ${target.sha}, expected ${releaseSha}`)
              }
            }

            try {
              verifyTag(await getTagTarget())
              return
            } catch (error) {
              if (error.status !== 404) throw error
            }

            try {
              await github.rest.git.createRef({ owner, repo, ref: `refs/tags/${tag}`, sha: releaseSha })
            } catch (error) {
              if (error.status !== 422) throw error
              verifyTag(await getTagTarget())
            }

  release-pypi:
    name: publish to PyPI
    needs: [release-build]
    # Not success(): v2-schema-frozen is skipped on tag runs, and a skipped job anywhere in the
    # needs chain makes success() false. Including a status function also prevents GitHub from
    # implicitly wrapping this expression in success().
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.release-build.result == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: release-pypi
      url: https://pypi.org/project/genai-prices/${{ needs.release-build.outputs.version }}
    permissions:
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: release-pypi-dist
          path: dist/

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@08807647e7069bb48b6ef5acd8ec9567f424441b # v8.1.0
        with:
          version: "0.12.1"
          enable-cache: false

      - run: uv publish --trusted-publishing always

  release-npm:
    name: publish to npm
    needs: [release-build]
    # Keep this explicit status function in sync with release-pypi; see the comment above.
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.release-build.result == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: release-npm
      url: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pydantic/genai-prices/v/${{ needs.release-build.outputs.version }}
    permissions:
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.x
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
          package-manager-cache: false

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: release-npm-dist
          path: npm-dist/

      # Trusted publishing (OIDC) - no token; npm attaches provenance automatically.
      - run: npm publish ./npm-dist/pydantic-genai-prices-*.tgz --access public

  release-check:
    name: check release published
    needs: [release-pypi, release-npm, release-go]
    # This status function ensures the job still runs and reports a failure if a publish job is
    # skipped or fails. Without it, GitHub would silently skip this job too.
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Verify all release jobs succeeded
        uses: re-actors/alls-green@05ac9388f0aebcb5727afa17fcccfecd6f8ec5fe # v1.2.2
        with:
          jobs: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}

"""Run with the same harness and provider extras as the gh-aw engine."""

import importlib
import json
import os
import unittest
from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from unittest.mock import patch

from pydantic_ai.messages import ModelMessage, ToolReturnPart
from pydantic_ai.models.function import AgentInfo, DeltaToolCall, FunctionModel

from scripts import price_check_agent


class PriceCheckAgentTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_tools(self) -> None:
        async def inspect_tools(messages: list[ModelMessage], info: AgentInfo) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
            del messages
            self.assertEqual(
                {tool.name for tool in info.function_tools},
                {'read_file', 'write_file', 'edit_file', 'list_files', 'grep', 'shell', 'web_fetch'},
            )
            yield 'checked'

        result = price_check_agent.agent.run_sync('Check tools.', model=FunctionModel(stream_function=inspect_tools))
        self.assertEqual(result.output, 'checked')

    def test_shell_environment(self) -> None:
        with patch.dict(
            os.environ,
            {
                'HTTPS_PROXY': 'http://proxy.example:3128',
                'GIT_AUTHOR_NAME': 'Price Check',
                'PRICE_CHECK_SCOPE_COMMAND': 'node /tmp/price-check-scope',
                'SSL_CERT_FILE': '/tmp/ca-bundle.pem',
                'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY': 'private-provider-key',
                'OPENAI_API_KEY': 'private-provider-key',
                'GH_AW_SESSION_FRAME_KEY': 'private-session-key',
                'GITHUB_TOKEN': 'private-github-token',
                'GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN': 'private-gh-aw-token',
                'SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL': 'private-slack-webhook',
                'LOGFIRE_OTLP_AUTHORIZATION': 'private-logfire-token',
            },
        ):
            agent = importlib.reload(price_check_agent).agent

        async def check_environment(
            messages: list[ModelMessage], info: AgentInfo
        ) -> AsyncIterator[str | dict[int, DeltaToolCall]]:
            del info
            returns = [part for message in messages for part in message.parts if isinstance(part, ToolReturnPart)]
            if not returns:
                yield {
                    0: DeltaToolCall(
                        name='shell',
                        json_args=json.dumps(
                            {
                                'command': "printf '%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s' "
                                '"${HTTPS_PROXY-}" "${GIT_AUTHOR_NAME-}" '
                                '"${PRICE_CHECK_SCOPE_COMMAND-}" "${SSL_CERT_FILE-}" '
                                '"${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY-}" "${OPENAI_API_KEY-}" '
                                '"${GH_AW_SESSION_FRAME_KEY-}" "${GITHUB_TOKEN-}" '
                                '"${GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN-}" "${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL-}" '
                                '"${LOGFIRE_OTLP_AUTHORIZATION-}"'
                            }
                        ),
                    )
                }
            else:
                self.assertIn(
                    'http://proxy.example:3128|Price Check|node /tmp/price-check-scope|/tmp/ca-bundle.pem|||||||',
                    str(returns[-1].content),
                )
                self.assertNotIn('private-', str(returns[-1].content))
                yield 'checked'

        result = agent.run_sync('Check shell environment.', model=FunctionModel(stream_function=check_environment))
        self.assertEqual(result.output, 'checked')

# Price check performance and follow-up plan

The 25-provider check still spends most of its work inside the model loop. The next changes should collect and compare
evidence in code, give provider agents only changed or unresolved work, and measure completeness alongside runtime.
The implementation stages below are proposals. The current workflow still runs one agent and checks every provider.

## Measured baseline

The [machine-readable measurements](../price-check/benchmark-2026-10-15.json) preserve the compact baseline independently
of Actions artifact retention. Raw transcripts remain in Actions artifacts; credentials and raw transcripts do not belong
in this repository.

| Measurement                     | [First 25-provider attempt][first-run] | [Successful follow-up][second-run] |
| ------------------------------- | -------------------------------------: | ---------------------------------: |
| Agent job                       |                                 89m30s |                             51m55s |
| Uncached input tokens           |                              2,617,858 |                            513,319 |
| Cached input reads              |                             37,988,032 |                         31,472,320 |
| Output tokens                   |                                580,912 |                            126,439 |
| Successful model requests       |                                    374 |                                180 |
| HTTP 429 responses              |                                    620 |                                  0 |
| Explicit research-task launches |                                     34 |                                  0 |
| WebFetch calls                  |                                    106 |                                 39 |

The follow-up ran source commit `614ae71063305ef9b79ecefc4d45531c16d3f060`. It differs from production commit
`94d27b8eafdeaddfeaef36fe290c468532fcdd4e` only in its literal test PR base and the compiled workflow.
It produced PR #793. These measurements describe execution, not the correctness of every proposed data change.

The first run reached 17 simultaneous research tasks. The follow-up disabled Claude's `Agent` and legacy `Task` tools.
This comparison shows reduced runtime and rate-limit pressure; it does not isolate causation or establish that one agent
is optimal. Neither run measures an unchanged steady state.

### Accounting method

Download the `agent` artifact for the exact run, before its retention period expires:

```bash
gh run download 38768031115 --repo pydantic/genai-prices --name agent --dir price-check-artifact
```

`agent-stdio.log` mixes debug text and JSON records. Read complete JSON lines with `type: result` and use the last
cumulative `modelUsage` object for each CLI session. Do not add repeated cumulative objects. In the first run, four result
events repeat the same cumulative object. If an invocation resumes or resets a session, establish its accounting scope
before combining results.

`modelUsage` covers more calls than the result's top-level `usage`. In the follow-up, top-level output was 72,073 while
`modelUsage` output was 126,439. The archive does not establish the internal reason for that difference.
The API proxy's 180 unique successful `/v1/messages` request IDs independently sum to 126,439 output tokens.
Deduplicate proxy records by request ID. `usage/agent/token_usage.jsonl` is a duplicate of the agent's proxy usage file;
never sum both copies.

The proxy reports zero input and cache counts for this endpoint. Use the CLI's per-model input and cache fields; do not
interpret proxy zeros as zero consumption. Keep cached reads separate from uncached input. Client `costUSD` estimates
are not authoritative provider billing. See [Claude usage accounting][usage-docs].

Logfire MCP was authenticated during the investigation, but scoped to `logfire/pydantic-ai`. No matching run was found
in that accessible project. The measurements above came from Actions archives, not Logfire queries.

## Trace findings

- The manifest requires 37 source URLs. The follow-up fetched 37 unique URLs, but missed the required Moonshot
  `chat-k27-code.md` and `chat-k26.md` URLs. A count alone cannot establish coverage.
- The 39 fetch calls contain only two repeated URLs: a truncated/unreadable Vertex retry and a targeted Voyage follow-up.
  Cross-run reuse offers more remaining savings than removing duplicate fetches in this run.
- Model-matching investigation repeated source searches around Gemini TTS. A tool exposing existing matching behavior
  can resolve aliases and collisions without asking an agent to rediscover engine semantics.
- Validation started three times. The first two attempts stopped during build: an environment/import failure and unsorted
  Baseten model IDs. Only the final attempt ran the complete validation chain successfully.
- Eight sleep/tail polling commands created extra model roundtrips while waiting for real validation. Process supervision
  can remove those roundtrips, but cannot remove the underlying test runtime.

## Implementation stages

### 1. Make each run observable and reproducible

Export agent and request spans to the dedicated `logfire/genai-prices` project. Grant MCP access to the same project.
Correlate repository, run ID, attempt and commit; add provider and phase when the provider execution boundary exists.
Export cumulative CLI accounting separately from proxy counters until input/cache reporting is reconciled.
Record tool names, duration, coverage, retries and validation outcomes alongside token usage.

The first follow-up exports recorded proxy spans, cumulative per-model CLI usage and tool-use counts in a trusted post-agent
step. The Logfire credential is scoped only to that step. A CLI smoke event and readback verified the dedicated instance's
`.info` ingestion endpoint. MCP readback works with `project: logfire/genai-prices` after `codex mcp login logfire`.
The unqualified `genai-prices` name is rejected despite appearing in the error's available-project list.
The actual exporter was replayed against the archived follow-up without new LLM calls. MCP recovered 188 request spans,
one agent span and one cumulative usage span. This validates export and readback; a future workflow run must still verify
the compiled step inside Actions. Provider phase spans and individual tool durations remain follow-up work.

For future runs, start with `agent/telemetry.json` inside the `agent` artifact or the `price_check.usage` span.
For the archived follow-up, pass `start_timestamp: 2026-10-15T16:15:00Z` and
`end_timestamp: 2026-10-15T17:20:00Z` to MCP. Its default recent window will not find this historical run.

```sql
SELECT attributes->>'gen_ai.request.model' AS model,
       attributes->>'price_check.usage.uncached_input' AS uncached_input,
       attributes->>'price_check.usage.cached_input' AS cached_input,
       attributes->>'price_check.usage.cache_creation' AS cache_creation,
       attributes->>'price_check.usage.output' AS output
FROM records
WHERE span_name = 'price_check.usage'
  AND otel_resource_attributes->>'gh-aw.run.id' = '38768031115'
LIMIT 10
```

Acceptance: query an exact run through MCP, recover its request count and complete token components, and locate failed
tools or phases without downloading the whole transcript. Missing export must be visible in the run summary.

### 2. Fetch and compare evidence in code

Add a manifest-driven fetch ledger with per-source retrieval and readability status. Fetch shared URLs once per run.
Use a shared bounded HTTP pool and retry policy. A failed or partial source remains explicitly unresolved.

Feed existing pure parsers for Arcee, Cloudflare, Cursor and Baseten into typed evidence records. Include canonical IDs,
aliases, each price key and tier, units, scope, effective-date evidence and source URL. Reuse Decimal conversions and
the existing matching/pricing logic. Report collisions and unsupported shapes explicitly.

Do not invoke importer writers blindly. Their update policy can date a change at the run date; a verified price effective
date is a separate requirement. Add shape and completeness checks where a parser can skip malformed rows.

Acceptance: omissions, malformed source rows, wrong units and alias collisions produce explicit findings. Readable
unchanged fixtures yield no candidates. Existing historical prices and scoped overrides remain intact.

### 3. Bound provider agents and use one finisher

Dispatch one due provider per task with its compact evidence and ownership of only its provider YAML. Share downloaded
evidence. Return structured findings and a provider patch; prohibit nested delegation and shared-file edits.
Start an experiment with three concurrent provider tasks, enforced by the controller rather than prompt wording.
Measure concurrency one versus three against the same source snapshot and provider set.

The pinned Claude CLI is 2.1.198. The native configurable subagent concurrency/depth limits require 2.1.217 or later.
Verify a compatible CLI upgrade or enforce the provider-session pool outside the CLI before removing the current deny.
Do not rely on an environment variable unsupported by the installed CLI.

After provider tasks finish, one finisher combines their patches, checks coverage and evidence, builds generated files,
updates affected regression assertions, and runs the full validation sequence. Provider agents do not run full builds,
edit generated files, commit, or publish. A separate review examines the combined provider diff and evidence before
publication. The finisher retains explicit unresolved findings even when it can propose independent verified changes.

Add cheap environment/import and model-order preflight checks. The workflow already syncs dependencies, so diagnose
the environment lifecycle before adding another installation step. Supervise validation in code and return compact errors.

Acceptance: concurrency stays within the configured pool, only the finisher touches shared artifacts, every due provider
has a result, and comparison against the sequential baseline measures coverage, tokens, retries and latency together.

### 4. Reuse evidence and select providers by cadence

Persist verified evidence with HTTP validators/content hashes and manifest, YAML, unit-registry and parser versions.
Revalidate sources before reuse. Preserve unresolved/deferred findings and invalidate when a scheduled price takes effect.
An error page, empty parse or incomplete prior check cannot produce a clean unchanged result.
Skip model execution when due providers have complete, unchanged evidence and no unresolved work requiring judgment.

Proposed initial cadence, within the existing weekday America/Los_Angeles window:

| Provider group                          | Cadence         |
| --------------------------------------- | --------------- |
| OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI and Meta | Hourly          |
| Other covered providers                 | Every two hours |

Treat OpenAI and OpenAI Decisions as one scheduling group while retaining separate coverage records.
Use explicit manifest cadence/priority fields and a deterministic due-provider selector. Record the last successful
verification, so failures do not postpone the next check or make a provider appear fresh. Provide a manual all-provider
override. Select due providers before any model work and retain one coordinated publication path.

Adjust tiers using observed usage and change frequency. Do not infer usage from provider nationality or company size.
Keep freshness requirements separate from evidence caching: an unchanged source still needs its due revalidation.

Acceptance: an unchanged verified fixture invokes no model, a changed or unresolved source reaches the relevant provider
task, cache invalidation covers data/parser/time changes, and hourly/two-hour selection is tested at scheduling boundaries.

Benchmark an unchanged run and a changed run after each stage. Compare complete provider coverage and correct findings
before interpreting lower duration or fewer tokens as an improvement. Grok/X discovery remains a separate experiment.

# Agentic price-update workflow

```bash
gh secret set ZAI_API_KEY
gh secret set LOGFIRE_OTLP_AUTHORIZATION
gh variable set PRICE_UPDATE_APP_CLIENT_ID --body Iv23libntR0K6oyQrZWX
gh secret set PRICE_UPDATE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY < /path/to/genai-prices-automation.private-key.pem
gh secret set SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL
gh variable set AGENTIC_WORKFLOWS_ENABLED --body true
gh workflow run agentic-price-check.lock.yml
```

This [gh-aw](https://github.com/github/gh-aw) workflow schedules a check of all twenty-five covered provider records
each Monday at 06:00 UTC and supports manual dispatch. The same invocation also revisits pending requested-model rollouts from Genie Pricer. See the [gh-aw schedule syntax] and
[GitHub Actions schedule syntax]. The workflow combines
verified new models and rate changes into one ready-for-review PR titled `Update provider prices`. Scheduled runs target
`main`. Manual dispatch uses `main` unless you select a branch with `--ref`.
A separate job sends that PR's link to Slack. Runs with no verified changes send no notification. You can read skipped
findings in the PR body and noop reasons in the workflow run's summary.
Runs remain serial, with up to 100 pending runs in the concurrency group; GitHub cancels additional runs once the queue is
full. See [GitHub Actions concurrency].

One manual [workflow run 38748564180](https://github.com/pydantic/genai-prices/actions/runs/38748564180) on
`codex/price-check-coverage-runtime` on 2026-10-15 took 89m30s. Its telemetry recorded 1,004 model API
request spans, including 620 HTTP 429 responses and two HTTP 502 responses, alongside 34 research-task launches and a peak
of 17 active tasks. Price Check uses `Coder(sub_agents=False)` to keep research in one execution context.
This historical measurement describes one Claude Code run and does not predict CLAI 2 runtime.

See [performance measurements and implementation plan](AGENTIC_PRICE_CHECK_PERFORMANCE.md) for the subsequent
51m55s run, whole-run token accounting, evidence gaps, and the proposed deterministic checks and bounded parallelism.

## Configuration

| Variable or secret             | Purpose                                                                                             |
| ------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `AGENTIC_WORKFLOWS_ENABLED`    | Set this repository variable to `true` to enable the checks.                                        |
| `ZAI_API_KEY`                  | Repository secret held by the API proxy for GLM-5.3-Flash through Z.ai's Anthropic-compatible API.  |
| `PRICE_UPDATE_APP_CLIENT_ID`   | Repository variable containing the GenAI Prices Automation App's client ID: `Iv23libntR0K6oyQrZWX`. |
| `PRICE_UPDATE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY` | Repository secret containing the App's complete PEM private key.                                    |
| `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL`            | Slack incoming-webhook URL for the channel that should receive price-update PR links.               |
| `LOGFIRE_OTLP_AUTHORIZATION`   | Repository secret containing the complete `Bearer …` authorization value for Logfire.               |

You choose the Slack channel when you create the incoming webhook. Store its URL as a secret, never in a workflow or prompt.
The notification job uses the `price-updates` GitHub environment. You can restrict that environment to your default branch
and store the webhook secret there instead of at repository scope. The job fails if the secret is missing or Slack rejects
the request. It does not undo a successfully created PR.

The workflow imports the public [Pydantic AI engine] and runs CLAI 2 with harness version `0.56.0`.
`engine.model: anthropic/glm-5.3-flash` selects the Anthropic Messages protocol. The engine removes the
`anthropic/` routing prefix before sending the model ID upstream. gh-aw configures the API proxy to forward
`/v1/messages` to `https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic/v1/messages` and inject `ZAI_API_KEY` as `x-api-key`.
The sandbox receives a placeholder key; the provider secret remains in the proxy.
See Z.ai's [model documentation][zai-model] and [endpoint guide][zai-api].

`PAI_AGENT: scripts.price_check_agent:agent` selects the workflow's tool composition. It binds gh-aw's published
proxy-aware fetcher as `web_fetch`, adds Coder's filesystem and shell tools, and disables delegation. The shell retains proxy,
toolchain, and Git identity settings while excluding provider credential variables. The public engine supplies
the launcher, MCP composition, session recorder, and model routing. The pinned proxy retains its 500-request
limit; there is no workflow output-token cap.
This custom engine does not enforce gh-aw's `tools.bash` patterns. Coder supplies the shell; AWF controls network access,
and the trusted safe-output handler enforces the proposed file scope.

The fetcher permits only HTTPS origins from the provider manifest, rejects credentials and non-public DNS results,
and repeats these checks on every redirect. It delegates final DNS and routing to AWF's required proxy; there is no
direct-network fallback. TLS certificate verification remains enabled. Fetch results include pagination metadata;
use `start_index` to continue truncated content. Pydantic AI's default local fetcher pins an IP in CONNECT, which
AWF deliberately denies; trusting the proxy's rejection certificate would not fix the denied request.

The manifest origins are snapshotted before model execution as trusted operator configuration. The DNS preflight is defense in depth: Squid resolves the
hostname independently, so it does not pin the proxy's final destination IP or prevent resolver divergence/rebinding.
The tool's destination boundary is the exact official-origin allowlist plus verified HTTPS, rather than arbitrary-URL
fetching. Keep that allowlist on redirects; supporting untrusted origins requires destination-IP enforcement at the proxy.

`shared/price-check-engine.md` holds routing configuration and an explicit package pin. Import that file before
the public definition. gh-aw v0.91.1 validates root environment secrets before loading imported engine metadata,
and does not inherit the public version into this configuration. Keep the model preference in the source workflow.
Keep `excluded-env` in the routing import too: this engine ignores the root field in v0.91.1.

### Logfire telemetry

After the agent exits, a trusted step exports API-proxy request spans, an agent span and canonical gh-aw usage to the dedicated
[genai-prices Logfire project](https://logfire-eu.pydantic.info/logfire/genai-prices).
`LOGFIRE_OTLP_AUTHORIZATION` supplies the project's write credential. MCP access is a separate authorization:
grant the Logfire MCP connection access to `logfire/genai-prices` before querying these runs.
Pass the fully qualified `project: logfire/genai-prices` to MCP queries. The unqualified name can be rejected even when
the error lists that name as available. Run `codex mcp login logfire` if authorization still targets another project.
The credential exists only in the export step, outside the agent sandbox. The pinned compiler's native OTLP configuration
would expose exporter headers through its agent environment, so this workflow does not use that configuration.
Export failures appear in the run summary and export step without blocking independently validated price updates.

Filter telemetry by `gh-aw.repository = pydantic/genai-prices` and the exact `gh-aw.run.id`.
Check both span attributes and resource attributes because components can put run identifiers in either place.
Confirm a run's request spans arrive before treating export configuration as verified.
The separate `price_check.usage` span records cumulative `agent_usage.json` components under
`price_check.usage.uncached_input`, `cached_input`, `cache_creation` and `output`, labelled with
`price_check.usage.source = gh-aw.agent_usage`. Do not add that rollup to individual proxy counts.
Historical proxy versions reported zero input/cache counts; those zeros do not establish zero consumption.
The `invoke_agent` span records canonical tool execution counts and `price_check.terminal_output_emitted`.
That field means the agent emitted a terminal item; check the separate `safe_outputs` job for acceptance or rejection.
Coder's CodeMode calls appear as `run_code`. The canonical session contains each call's code and returned output;
nested tool responses that the code does not return are not recorded separately.
The `agent` artifact includes `mcp-logs/price-check-telemetry.json` with the compact per-run accounting and tool counts, so future
investigations can start there without processing the full transcript. Dollar fields remain client estimates.

[GenAI Prices Automation](https://github.com/apps/genai-prices-automation), App ID `1641661`, must be installed on
`pydantic/genai-prices` with **Contents: read/write** and **Pull requests: read/write**. You can generate a private key in
[the App's settings](https://github.com/organizations/pydantic/settings/apps/genai-prices-automation) under **Private keys**.
Store the complete downloaded PEM file as `PRICE_UPDATE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY`; never commit it or paste it into chat.

The permission-controlled `safe_outputs` job mints an installation token scoped only to `genai-prices`. Each run gets a
fresh short-lived token, which is revoked when the job finishes. App-created PRs trigger the repository's normal CI without
a personal access token. `PRICE_UPDATE_TOKEN` is no longer used. The agent's GitHub permissions remain read-only, and the
App private key is never passed to the agent. Slack credentials are passed only to `.github/workflows/price-update-slack.yml`.

### Slack notifications

Slack receives a message only after the workflow creates a ready-for-review PR. The message contains that PR's actual URL.
Skipped runs, clean checks, runs with only unverified findings, failed builds or tests, and authentication failures send no
Slack message. A created PR can include both verified updates and a list of skipped findings.
You can inspect failures and noop reasons in Actions. The App generates fresh short-lived tokens automatically, so there is
no personal-token expiry to monitor.

## Coverage

The weekly workflow is `.github/workflows/agentic-price-check.md`. [Genie Pricer](GENIE_PRICER.md) provides a separate targeted Slack entrypoint. It covers OpenAI, OpenAI Decisions, Anthropic, Google
(Gemini), Mistral, DeepSeek, xAI, Groq, Cerebras, MiniMax, MoonshotAI, Avian, Perplexity, Cohere, Voyage AI, Cloudflare
Workers AI, Cursor, Arcee, Baseten, GitHub Copilot, Databricks, TypeSafe, Z.AI, Meta, and Modal.

You define each provider's scope, official URLs, and pricing mappings in `.github/agentic-price-check-providers.yml`.
Each run reads that manifest once, completes research provider by provider, and starts one full validation pass after edits
and diff review are complete. Each official response is reused for the in-scope models it covers.
The workflow creates at most one PR per run. It skips while any PR authored by `app/genai-prices-automation` remains open,
including proposals from the previous three workflows. The hourly `Update prices` PR on `automation/hourly-price-update`
is the exception: it does not block this check. Renaming a PR does not bypass this guard. Merge or close those
proposals to resume checks. The workflow does not merge PRs, force-push branches, or close older proposals.

These checks complement `make check-for-price-discrepancies`, which uses aggregators such as LiteLLM and OpenRouter.

## Update safeguards

The workflow prompt and shared instructions in `.github/workflows/shared/price-update.md` require the agent to:

- Check existing canonical IDs and match rules before adding models. Do not add aliases as separate models.
- Compare all registry units and published tiers, resolving the last matching conditional record for each usage scope.
  Ignore shadowed historical rates and insert dated updates before later scope overrides and scheduled future rates.
  Do not guess missing prices or effective dates.
- Preserve historical prices. Insert dated conditional records for real rate changes; correct values in place only with
  evidence that the recorded price was already wrong. Defer changes with unverified timing or correction evidence.
  Test requests before and on each effective date in Python, JavaScript, and Go.
- Edit only the workflow's provider YAML. Regenerate artifacts with `make build`, never by hand.
- Run `make lint`, `make typecheck`, `make lint-go`, `make test`, `npm run ci`, and `make test-go` before proposing a PR.
  Update affected regression expectations in all three languages without weakening assertions.
- Leave frozen v1 data, the unit registry, and published v2 schemas unchanged.
- Include official source URLs, unit conversions, validation results, unchecked findings, and the AI disclaimer in the PR body.

The safe-output file allowlist permits only the covered providers, generated v2 and bundled data, the provider inventory, and
price regression assertions. It blocks code, dependencies, workflows, agent instructions, and registry changes. There is no
fallback issue when PR creation fails. Its existing 10 MiB patch limit accommodates the generated full-data snapshot.
Failures remain visible in Actions; Slack is reserved for created PRs.

The preflight snapshots the same allowlist and initial source SHA before agent execution. It reuses gh-aw's file-policy
validator and runs before commits, from AWF's read-only mounted directory. The agent also checks scope before validation.
The allowlist includes the existing `tests/test_price_check_additions.py` regression file. Candidates requiring other
regression files outside the allowlist are deferred. The trusted safe-output handler remains
the final scope gate; the preflight gives the agent feedback while it can still correct the proposal.

Unreadable sources, ambiguous mappings, missing fields, and potential removals are not safe edits. They appear in a PR's
skipped-findings section if another change can be verified, or in the noop summary otherwise. A partial check is not reported
as clean. A missing model on a pricing page is never enough evidence to remove it.

## Edit and compile

```bash
gh extension install github/gh-aw --pin v0.91.1
gh aw compile --no-check-update agentic-price-check
```

The `.md` files are source. The `.lock.yml` files are compiled output. Never edit a lock file by hand. Compile this
workflow with the pinned version; other workflows can use a different compiler version.

The public engine requires gh-aw v0.91.1 or newer for canonical sessions and schema-valid merged usage.
This workflow pins v0.91.1 and firewall 0.28.31. Keep `max-ai-credits: -1` and `max-daily-ai-credits: -1`:
the compiler omits the configurable per-run credit budget and disables token steering. AWF still enforces
its fixed, non-configurable 10,000-credit ceiling. A custom upstream also disables
model fallback, preserving `glm-5.3-flash`.

`models.default-ai-credits-pricing` supplies fallback accounting in USD per million tokens, avoiding
`unknown_model_ai_credits` for an unrecognized model. Catalog pricing takes precedence over this fallback.
`models.providers.anthropic` supplies an accounting
overlay in USD per token, used for reporting and credit enforcement before catalog/fallback pricing for this provider.
Both use Z.ai's [published API rates][zai-pricing],
checked on 2026-10-15.
These are API-equivalent accounting figures, not Coding Plan charges or quota measurements. Threat detection
remains disabled under the existing safe-output policy.

### Verify a branch run

```bash
gh workflow run agentic-price-check.lock.yml --ref codex/price-check-clai2-engine
```

Check that the `agent` job executed; a successful `pre_activation` followed by skipped jobs is not an engine test.
An open Automation App PR still triggers the production skip guard on manual runs.
Inspect the `agent` artifact's `agent-session.jsonl` for model, tool calls/results, and the terminal result.
Inspect `usage/aw_session.jsonl` and the API-proxy audit for reported usage and upstream request outcomes.
Confirm that safe outputs processed a real noop or created a PR. A noop must skip `notify_slack`;
a created PR must pass its actual URL to the unchanged Slack workflow. Preserve run URLs and source SHAs
when recording verification.

The trusted host exporter described above uses service `gh-aw.agentic-price-check`, with the Actions run identity.
Native in-process model/tool export is deliberately disabled; exporter variables are excluded from the agent container.
The canonical session and usage artifacts remain available without an exporter. Missing Logfire rows or zero-valued
provider usage fields do not prove zero consumption. Compare only runs that reached the agent, and distinguish
reported tokens from Coding Plan quota consumption.

To add a provider to the ordinary weekly sweep, update `.github/agentic-price-check-providers.yml`, update the shared network policy if needed, and
add its YAML path to `create-pull-request.allowed-files` in both `agentic-price-check.md` and
`agentic-model-price-check.md`. Then recompile both workflows.

## Source limitations

`web-fetch` does not execute JavaScript. A pricing page rendered entirely in JavaScript can appear empty. Point the workflow
at an official static documentation page when one exists. Never replace an unreadable official source with cached snippets,
aggregator prices, or remembered values.
